Highly Skilled Migrant

If you want to work in the Netherlands as a highly skilled migrant, your employer must be a recognised sponsor.

Salary threshold

You must earn a gross monthly salary of at least EUR 5,688 if you are 30 years or older. For applicants under 30 the threshold is EUR 4,171 per month.

Recognised sponsor

Your employer must be registered as a recognised sponsor with the IND before the application is submitted.

Application

The employer submits the application on your behalf. The IND aims to decide within two weeks for recognised sponsors.
